title: capsella faucialis
intro: Capsella faucialis, commonly known as shepherd's purse, is a flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. The therapeutic actions of shepherd's purse include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and hemostatic properties, which make it useful for treating bleeding and wounds. The bioactive constituents of shepherd's purse include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
